description: Read retained events from connected Buoy sources. Filter with sources, such as ['network'], ['redux'], ['react-query'], ['storage'] or ['route']. Returns compact summaries by default; use includeData:true for available payload details. Coverage depends on integrations and retention. An empty timeline does not prove an event never happened. Use get_network_requests for request IDs and get_snapshot for available current tool state.

deviceId.description: The device to act on: its id from list_devices or from your instructions. Pass it whenever more than one app may be connected. Once a call names a device, later calls in this session use it when deviceId is left out.

includeData.description: Include each event's full raw payload (HEAVY — network bodies, state trees). Default false (compact).

limit.description: Most-recent N events to include. Default 25.

preset.description: Start from a named Copy-Settings preset (then your other args override it).

sources.description: Only these sources. Coarse names accepted: "network", "redux", "react-query", "storage", "route", "render", "zustand", "jotai", "capacitor" (Capacitor plugin calls). Omit for all.

name: get_events
